blurb.text: A state with one of the oldest wine-making traditions in the United States. Friars planted the first wine grapes in 1629 in what is now the Middle Rio Grande Valley AVA. Its AVAs are Middle Rio Grande Valley, Mesilla Valley and Mimbres Valley.
